summary: Backend complete-flow regression passed, but required auth lockout and mobile persistent-auth checks exposed failures. API registration, workspace, preset publish, public feedback, response storage, and 4.7 analytics remain passing.

minor.issue: Six consecutive invalid-password attempts for one newly registered email all returned 401; the fifth attempt did not lock the identifier and the sixth was not 429.

integration_issues.issue: After workspace POST returned 200, the UI stayed on onboarding and dashboard metrics never appeared in the persistent browser context. Backend logs showed no subsequent dashboard summary request.

action_items: Fix login attempt identity/persistence so five failures for the same email reliably return 429 on subsequent attempts; verify through ingress/proxy client variation.
Fix workspace-submit success navigation/state so dashboard fetch occurs and onboarding does not remain visible; retest reload persistence and public responsive page.
critical_code_review_comments: Login lockout key combines client.host with email, which is not a stable identifier behind the preview ingress and allows repeated failures to bypass the required per-identifier lockout.

Onboarding navigation relies on nav('/dashboard') after workspace creation but the observed browser context remained on onboarding despite a 200 POST; add explicit success/state handling and investigate route/state behavior.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (registration rendered; workspace POST succeeded; dashboard/public browser journey blocked)

seed_data_creation: Created one unique API regression owner/workspace/template/response, one unique UI registration owner/workspace, and one lockout-test owner.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Complete API flow and analytics average 4.7 pass. Reproduce lockout with six wrong logins and reproduce mobile onboarding stall in one browser context before testing public controls.
rca of the issue: Lockout attempts are keyed by request client host plus email; preview ingress can make host-derived identity unstable, so the stored count is not consistently reused. The mobile workspace request succeeds but no dashboard summary request follows and the onboarding component remains visible, indicating frontend navigation/state transition failure or an unhandled post-success route transition.
